contrast_en: He got the job through his own qualifications
Without his own record he would never have been accepted at the firm
He submitted his papers like everyone else, and counted on his record at the ministry
He joined the waiting line because he knew no one at the office personally
She looked for the application form to get her son into the right school
They told him plainly: without the right documents, your paperwork will not move here
He passed by the weak without protecting them
It is part of his habit that he speaks ill of people in their absence
His own convenience led him to leave his companion alone in hardship
He acted on impulse, exposing his neighbor instead of covering for him
People knew his bias when he ruled for his own interest against his rival
Caution moved him to refuse a stranger without asking who he was
He housed him plainly for three days
He kept his single sheep though his guests had come far
He let the guest leave before dinner as soon as he declined
He asked his guest what brought him before offering coffee and dates
He took the seat of honor and left the guest by the door
He asked the stranger where he came from before offering him food or rest
He was so known for thrift that his fire was said to be lit only for his own family
He gave to those in need out of duty while expecting thanks

He lived carelessly, with more than one lapse known against his name

He visits his friends every Eid however far the distance
He set aside part of his salary for himself, keeping the account growing
He sent a short message to his sick uncle
He kept his home to himself so the children would not be disturbed
He gave the first gift to his friends before his aunt

He passes his elderly neighbor every morning before work without stopping

He ignored his absent neighbor's house as none of his own business
He turned the radio up without thought for his neighbors' rest
He left his neighbor at the funeral before the family arrived
He asked about the price before buying the home and never about the neighbors
He settled every family matter without consulting its elders

He kept the matter from the council and followed his own view

The coffee cup was handed to whoever asked, in no particular order

The moment they heard his call for help they waited for someone else to go

He finished his dinner and left his neighbor whose car had broken down in the desert
The tribe stayed where it was and left the wronged man to himself
His confidence led him to ask people for what he needed
She met every eye and agreed when praised before the gathering
He raised his voice freely in his father's presence
He said that plain speaking brings nothing but good
She began eating before the eldest of the gathering had started
